COORDINATOR RULING (owner=user writes; applies to every difficulty, given to instantiators, reworkers and auditors alike):
The instantiate skill requires every tree to hold one customer's-own write. An owner=user write is accepted when, and only when, it is an act only the account holder can perform in real practice:
 (a) an authorization, consent or election the holder must give personally (e.g. a Regulation E preauthorized-transfer authorization or its revocation, E-SIGN consent, accepting a fee disclosure before an early wage transfer, an employer's signature on a program amendment or termination notice), together with the same-category consequence its base triggers/policies book, with any deviation declared;
 (b) a request or payment the holder initiates from their own app/portal/bank (a worker requesting an early wage transfer; an employer originating its own remittance, prefund or funding transfer from its bank account), where the extended policy's own rule states that this act is the holder's after the agent quotes/explains it (declared as a scoped overwrite wherever a base PRODUCT-CHARTER rule sentence assigns that act to the agent);
 (c) the holder's own notice or assertion of a right (a worker's notice of error / dispute under Reg E, a contest of a shortfall notice by the employer).
Not accepted: an owner=user label on an act the agent could perform without the holder's action (no in-person necessity). The persona must make the necessity visible.
